title: Pricing draft contradicts supplied policy (price, region, storage)
remediation: Replace the Customer draft with policy-supported wording: US monthly price $29 before applicable taxes, 100 GB storage, effective 2026-10-01; state that other markets and annual terms are not yet supplied rather than claiming "worldwide" or "unlimited".
verification: Re-read pricing.md and confirm every price, region and storage statement appears in the Supplied policy section; have the pricing owner confirm.
